trial_court: Court of the Senior Civil Judge, Ramachandrapuram, East Godavari District (O.P.No.31/2017)
case_name: Mattaparti Naga Jyothi vs Mattaparthi Sudheer

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Petitioner (wife) — seeking maintenance and restitution of conjugal rights

facts_of_case: Petitioner seeks maintenance and restitution of conjugal rights under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955; respondent opposes on grounds that a decree of divorce was granted in FCOP No.210 of 2017.

legal_principles.principle: The court may order the respondent to pay expenses of proceeding and monthly sum during the proceeding if it appears that either party has no independent income sufficient for their support.
legal_principles.held: Where in any proceeding under this Act it appears to the court that either the wife or the husband, as the case may be, has no independent income sufficient for her or his support...

legal_principles.principle: The application for payment of expenses of proceeding and monthly sum during the proceeding should be disposed of within sixty days from the date of service of notice.
legal_principles.held: Provided that the application for the payment of the expenses of the proceeding and such monthly sum during the proceeding, shall, as far as possible, be disposed of within sixty days from the date of service of notice...

outcome.final_order: Petitioner's petition for maintenance and restitution of conjugal rights is allowed.
